subject.title: fix(skill-workshop): validate apply body and show change summary before destructive writes

question: Should low-overlap Skill Workshop replacements force pending approval even when the operator selected the automatic approval policy?
rationale: The code can implement either behavior safely, but overriding an existing approval preference is a compatibility and operator-expectation choice that repository history does not settle automatically.

options.title: Require approval for suspicious replacements
options.body: Keep the forced-pending exception for low-overlap updates as a narrow safeguard against destructive replacement content.

options.title: Preserve automatic approval semantics
options.body: Honor `auto` for structurally valid proposals and introduce a separate explicit strict-safety policy if maintainers want additional replacement review.

recommendation.title: Require approval for suspicious replacements
recommendation.body: Keep the forced-pending exception for low-overlap updates as a narrow safeguard against destructive replacement content.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work established the current automatic approval behavior that this PR proposes to narrow.
